title: MOOR OS — Funnel Citadel / Living Constitutional District
page0: Turn the current Funnel Hall into an actual traversable environment in MOOR OS / the Morverse. It must be beautiful, architecturally designed end to end, alive, detailed, explorable, and important. Replace mediocre glass-ball node representation with high-quality holographic laser geometry. Use the Funnel to ask the best questions, build the blueprint, expand every important detail, begin building it into Pulse, plan future reasons to return, support future desirable property around important places, and start a reusable world-building system so all MOOR locations can become meaningful rather than decorative.
correctedQuestion: What complete spatial, architectural, systemic, social, economic, technical, and world-building design makes the Funnel Citadel a beautiful place people deliberately revisit, while keeping the live Funnel graph truthful and establishing a reusable Location Contract for future Morverse places?
funnelQuestions: Why does this place exist in-world beyond visualizing a graph?
What must a first-time visitor understand within 30 seconds without reading documentation?
What should be visible from the arrival threshold, and what should only reveal itself through exploration?
Which live Funnel states deserve physical monuments, rooms, routes, sounds, lights, or rituals?
How can graph nodes become holographic laser instruments rather than decorative balls while remaining selectable and legible?
What architecture makes the whole building memorable from silhouette, floor plan, interior procession, material language, and light behavior?
Where are the quiet zones, social zones, operational zones, observation zones, and future expansion seams?
What makes the environment feel occupied and causally alive even when no other human is present?
What future activities create legitimate reasons to return instead of artificial retention mechanics?
How can property near an important location become desirable without selling power over public infrastructure?
What ownership, permissions, provenance, event, economy, and persistence boundaries are required before property can become real?
What details survive low-quality mobile rendering so the location keeps its identity?
What must be procedural, deterministic, instanced, or LOD-managed so the location can scale without becoming expensive noise?
What evidence proves the environment is navigable, graph-truthful, mobile-operable, and visually hierarchical?
What reusable world-building contract should every future MOOR location satisfy?
thesis: The Funnel Hall becomes the Funnel Citadel: MOOR's constitutional civic/technical landmark. The live Funnel graph is not shown as floating glass objects; it is projected as a spatial laser instrument suspended through a real architectural complex. The building itself teaches the Funnel by procession: arrival -> public nave -> live laser core -> observation ring -> Foundry/Refinery wings -> archive/receipt gallery -> future civic terraces and property district. Beauty comes from architecture, light, proportion, causal detail, material truth, quiet zones, and life systems—not from adding neon everywhere.

locationIdentity.worldRole: Constitutional infrastructure landmark and public observatory for MOOR creation law.
locationIdentity.promise: A visitor can see what governs creation, inspect what is live, understand what is candidate, trace why a build is allowed, and physically move through the systems that authorize MOOR creation.
importance: All MOOR build/change authorization conceptually passes through the Funnel law represented here.
Verified receipts, candidate laws, failures, references and reusable capability evidence gain a physical home.
The Citadel is a civic destination, not a private dashboard skin.
Its surrounding district can later host public institutions, exhibitions, workshops and private property without privatizing the Funnel itself.

architecturalMasterplan.site: A circular civic complex organized around a central laser well. Strong axial arrival from Create, concentric public circulation, two operational wings, an observation ring, exterior/edge expansion seams and a future district beyond the civic boundary.

hierarchy.accent: verified emerald events, people-scale detail, living material

zones.name: Arrival Threshold
zones.purpose: Compress scale and sound before revealing the core; establishes Citadel identity and orientation.

zones.name: Public Nave
zones.purpose: Primary traversable floor around the core with long sightlines, seating, information pylons and quiet negative space.

zones.name: Convergence Well
zones.purpose: Central live holographic laser representation of the current Funnel graph. Public, visible, not physically occupiable.

zones.name: Observation Ring
zones.purpose: Upper/perimeter vantage layer for reading the whole system and tracing relationships.

zones.name: Foundry Wing
zones.purpose: Operational doorway into Funnel Fabric/Foundry tools and blueprint assembly.

zones.name: Refinery Wing
zones.purpose: Capability Memory/reuse evidence and system-learning observatory.

zones.name: Receipt Gallery
zones.purpose: Future public provenance/history space for verified builds, failures, corrections and landmark receipts.

zones.name: Signal Garden
zones.purpose: Low-information biophilic decompression zone using deterministic ecology-compatible planters; no random decorative foliage.

zones.name: Citadel Edge
zones.purpose: Expansion seam for future transit, public events and the surrounding property district.

circulation: Ground loop remains continuously walkable around the central protected core.
Four cardinal thresholds keep orientation simple.
Foundry and Refinery occupy opposite wings so their relationship is spatially obvious.
Observation access is a deliberate lift/portal transition, not free-fly camera cheating.
No dead-end decorative corridors in the first implementation; every path resolves to a view, tool, information surface or future seam.

laserLanguage.rule: No glass-ball node field. Semantic entities use laser glyphs, rings, lattices, planes, beams and projected labels. Glass belongs to architecture/UI surfaces, not as the primary graph metaphor.
laserLanguage.funnelGlyph: Nested elliptical laser rings decreasing toward a focal point, joined by sparse generatrix beams to form a readable volumetric funnel lattice.
laserLanguage.lawActive: Emerald vertical beam + three orbit rings + grounded verified seal.
laserLanguage.lawCandidate: Ice-white split beam + open orbit ring; visibly unresolved without looking broken.
laserLanguage.ordinaryNode: Small laser crosshair/halo glyph with minimal physical footprint.
laserLanguage.edge: Curved or straight laser filament with a moving pulse only when the underlying relationship exists.
laserLanguage.flow: Deterministic phase seeded from edge identity; no Math.random reshuffle.
laserLanguage.labels: Projected only on selection/proximity or key landmarks; never a wall of permanent floating text.

architecture: warm neutral timber only in human/rest zones
light: very sparse warm light at seating/garden zones
surfaceTruth: plants receive local light rather than generic emissive glow

now: Deterministic laser traffic travels only on real graph edges.
Ceiling scanner arcs and architectural light breathe from a shared low-frequency building clock.
Small service drones follow fixed orbital/service routes around the core.
Signal Garden plants occupy designed planters and move from the same ambient field, not independent random animation.
Audio remains opt-in: low building resonance plus sparse directional data ticks near the core.
future: Scheduled public blueprint exhibitions and build launches.
Receipt/history installations that change as MOOR accumulates verified work.
Live law-change ceremonies when a candidate is promoted.
Community-guided tours, teaching sessions and public workshops.
Seasonal civic installations that do not rewrite the permanent architecture.

returnReasons.value: See and understand meaningful system changes in the place where they become visible.
Creators can display verified work and provenance in a prestigious public location.
Important builds and failures become inspectable history rather than disappearing into logs.
Foundry/Refinery learning becomes social and spatial.
Users can save graph views, traces and investigations without owning the public core.
Future residences/studios gain prestige and convenience from proximity to an important public institution.

propertyPlan.status: future-system; do not fake transactions in v1
propertyPlan.principle: Property is adjacent to civic value, never ownership of the Funnel, public routes, law, or authorization infrastructure.
propertyPlan.antiPayToWin: Location prestige, customization, social presence and convenience may be scarce; governance authority and build authorization may not be purchased.

worldbuildingContract.name: MOOR Location Contract v1
worldbuildingContract.law: A location is not complete because geometry exists. It must have a reason to exist, a reason to arrive, a reason to explore, a reason to return, a persistence boundary, and a recognizable identity under reduced quality.

technicalPlan.runtime: Three.js using the repository's existing module; no image generation or baked concept art dependency.
technicalPlan.graphTruth: FUNNEL_ENVIRONMENT_GRAPH remains the semantic source for laser entities and edges.
technicalPlan.determinism: Stable string hashes seed phase, drone routes, light offsets and procedural detail. Existing worlds do not reshuffle on reload.
technicalPlan.navigation: First-person drag/look + WASD/arrows + touch movement controls; protected central core; bounded civic floor; explicit level transition for observation layer.

qualityTiers.low: reduced ring segments, no secondary drones, simplified reflections, fewer architectural ribs and plants
qualityTiers.high: denser laser lattice, more architectural detail and secondary life without changing layout

technicalPlan.lodLaw: Remove micro detail before meso landmarks; never remove the central laser silhouette, axial arrival, ring circulation or wing identities.
technicalPlan.performanceBudget: Prefer instanced/reused geometry and shared materials. Cap DPR. Avoid per-frame allocations in hot loops. Pause secondary animation when hidden/reduced-motion.
technicalPlan.accessibility: Visible navigation alternatives, reduced motion, audio off by default, touch targets >=44px, high-contrast selected state.

buildNow: Replace sphere/glass graph nodes with holographic laser glyph geometry.
Build a real architectural shell with arrival axis, nave, central protected convergence well, perimeter ring, wing portals, seating, pylons, planters, ceiling ribs and observation cues.
Make ground circulation traversable with forward/back/strafe touch and keyboard controls.
Add deterministic graph-edge pulses, shared building clock, service-drone routes and restrained living detail.
Keep Foundry and Refinery as real tool handoffs.
Add zone/proximity HUD so the place reads as a location, not a free camera demo.
Add MOOR Location Contract documentation and register the super blueprint in Pulse/Funnel Fabric references.
Add verification that the runtime contains no sphere-node graph representation and still reads the live Funnel graph.
doneCriteria: The Citadel is a traversable Three.js environment, not an image.
The current Funnel graph remains the source of semantic geometry.
Graph nodes are represented with laser/ring/glyph geometry rather than sphere/glass balls.
The building has coherent macro/meso/micro architecture and recognizable zones.
Desktop and phone both have explicit movement/look controls.
Foundry and Refinery handoffs remain available.
Procedural animation is deterministic and shared-driver based.
Future social/property systems are planned but not falsely presented as implemented.
A reusable MOOR Location Contract exists for future world building.
Pulse indexes the blueprint and Citadel documentation.
